## Transformation of an ordinary detail

> She remembered the eggs, the butter, the pan heating—the meal she had made
> with ordinary care, now transformed inside her body. As she pushed, pressure
> became movement; the private ring of muscle expanded gradually around the
> emerging weight. Heat, stretch, smell, and the wet sound of release made the
> degradation physical rather than abstract.

The useful technique is continuity between an earlier mundane action and its
present bodily consequence. Do not merely label her filthy. Describe posture,
muscle effort, gradual change, temperature, weight, residue, smell, sound, her
view of what is happening, and the meaning she assigns to it.
